sv.title: Trots oenighet: Kan bli USA:s första svarta talman
sv.summary: Demokraterna i USA:s representanthus har röstat fram sin talmanskandidat – den nuvarande minoritetsledaren Hakeem Jeffries valdes, trots att inte alla i partiet är entusiastiska.

en.title: Despite disagreement: could become the USA's first Black speaker
en.summary: The Democrats in the US House of Representatives have voted in their speaker candidate – current minority leader Hakeem Jeffries was chosen, although not everyone in the party is enthusiastic.
